headline: Connelly Early shuts down the Rays to snap the Tampa win streak
morning_brew: Friday night at Fenway was a masterclass in starting pitching. Connelly Early went seven scoreless innings with eight strikeouts, making the Rays hitters look completely lost. Solo home runs from Wilyer Abreu and Ceddanne Rafaela provided all the offense we needed to secure a two to zero win. I been sayin' it all year, this rotation needs young arms like Early to step up and command the zone. Snapping that seven-game Tampa winning streak feels like a massive weight has been lifted.

The noise around Jaylen Brown and that blown lead against Philadelphia is not going away anytime soon. Stephen A. Smith is still hammering the point about Jaylen's comments, and the frustration in the Hub is palpable. It is hard to talk about favorite seasons when the series ended the way it did at the Garden. Fans are already looking at the roster to see how this team gets over the hump next year. We expect greatness in this town, and that means finishing the job when you have a team on the ropes.

Round two of the NHL playoffs is officially underway, and the Bruins are right in the thick of it as the five seed. After missing the postseason last year, seeing the black and gold back in the hunt is exactly what the city needed. Down in Foxborough, Caleb Lomu is getting his first taste of life as a professional. Building a wall in front of the quarterback is the top priority this offseason, and the rookie tackle seems ready for the challenge. Getting the young guys acclimated now is going to pay dividends when the real work starts in July.

news_digest.headline: Caleb Lomu's day to remember at Patriots intro
news_digest.dans_take: The rookie is already putting in the work to protect our next franchise quarterback.

news_digest.headline: Stephen A. has some words for Jaylen Brown
news_digest.dans_take: The talk won't stop until we see a different result on the parquet next season.

news_digest.dans_take: Always smart to see who might be the next cornerstone for the black and gold while we are still in the hunt.
